scope: Benchmark-wide question planning only; no implementation, source biological fixture reuse, or validated coverage added.

defaults.data: Independent observed biological inputs with pinned rights, provenance and transformations. A corpus train split can contain a task-internal held-out evaluation; task-internal labels remain private.
defaults.acceptance: Freeze complete output schemas, identity and eligibility rules, numerical or metric criteria and independent checks before solver evaluation. No LLM judge.
defaults.reference: Native package scripts read the supplied observations; a passing reference proves feasibility, not that every model must produce identical predictions.
defaults.runtime: Bound a scientifically meaningful question for a measured <=30-minute solve. Publish any preprocessing/start-boundary adaptation and do not claim stages that the task does not execute.
defaults.status: Shared-protocol adaptation only. All 350 individual systems retain endpoint-review gaps and zero predicted coverage.

questions.scientific_question: Which of two explicitly specified mechanistic models predicts independently held-out observed biological trajectories after unit and initial-condition reconciliation?
questions.source_scope: Shared mechanism-recovery protocol; no individual benchmark system assigned as an equivalent task.
observed_input_requirements: Observed biological time-course measurements with independent replicates, units, intervention labels, measurement uncertainty and licensed model definitions.
proposed_artifact_requirements: SBML model, SED-ML or explicit simulation settings, parameter/initial-condition table, measured/predicted trajectory table and residuals by replicate.
questions.deterministic_verifier_design: Check SBML semantics, stoichiometry and units; simulate the submitted model privately and grade complete held-out observed trajectories under a frozen noise-aware criterion. Structural identity is required only where specified, not inferred from similar trajectories.
questions.coverage_limit: Use independently observed benign biological kinetics. Simulations are computed model outputs, not invented input observations. Do not equate parameter or reaction recovery on one system with coverage of the 350 uninspected source systems.

questions.scientific_question: Which already measured intervention best distinguishes competing mechanisms under the observed noise and sampling design?
questions.source_scope: Shared mechanism-recovery protocol; no individual benchmark system assigned as an equivalent task.
observed_input_requirements: Independent observed baseline and intervention time courses; hold out intervention outcomes behind a deterministic query interface with a fixed query budget.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Candidate model predictions, acquisition/query ledger, selected measured intervention IDs, held-out likelihood or error comparison, and final uncertainty.
questions.deterministic_verifier_design: Replay query budget and returned observed records; recompute a fixed information or predictive-discrimination objective. The task chooses among already measured benign conditions, without experimental procedure generation.
questions.coverage_limit: Use independently observed benign biological kinetics. Simulations are computed model outputs, not invented input observations. Do not equate parameter or reaction recovery on one system with coverage of the 350 uninspected source systems.

questions.scientific_question: Which kinetic parameters are identifiable from the observed sampling design, and which remain confounded?
questions.source_scope: Shared mechanism-recovery protocol; no individual benchmark system assigned as an equivalent task.
observed_input_requirements: Independent observed replicate time courses, known measurement scale and an explicitly specified bounded kinetic model.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Profile likelihood or sensitivity tables, fit constraints, parameter intervals, residuals and predictions under eligible parameter sets.
questions.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute sensitivity/profile summaries and residuals; accept equivalent fitted parameter sets when predictions and stated identifiability pass. Do not demand one hidden parameter vector that observationally equivalent models cannot identify.
questions.coverage_limit: Use independently observed benign biological kinetics. Simulations are computed model outputs, not invented input observations. Do not equate parameter or reaction recovery on one system with coverage of the 350 uninspected source systems.
